name: KOA Speer Electronics Inc

about:
KOA Speer Electronics Inc is headquartered in Bradford, Pennsylvania, where it operates as a manufacturer of passive electronic components with a focus on resistor technologies.

The company’s product portfolio spans current sense resistors that leverage metal plate technology for large current detection, surge and pulse withstanding thick film resistors (SG73 series), thin film high precision resistors (RN73R, RN73H, and WN73H wide terminal series), wide terminal resistors designed for higher power ratings in compact footprints, and anti-sulfur resistors that use a high sulfuration-proof inner electrode material and metal glaze thick film. These resistors are offered in a wide range of sizes, power ratings, and resistance values, supporting downsizing and improved heat dissipation for board-level designs.

KOA Speer serves the automotive and industrial markets. Its automotive-grade resistors meet AEC-Q200 qualification, and the anti-sulfur line passes ASTM-B809 anti-sulfuration testing, making them suitable for harsh environments. The company also provides sample requests for design validation.

The company positions itself as a leader in anti-sulfuration chip resistors and a passive component partner, emphasizing metal plate technology for current sensing and robust construction for surge protection.
